build_gtn_python_package: build the gtn python package with cmake and setuptools for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn modules like graph, autograd, utils, rand, creations, functions, or parallel
review_cmakebuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that validates cmake version and orchestrates extension builds
review_cmakebuild_run: review the CMakeBuild run method that checks cmake >= 3.5.1 and builds all extensions
review_cmakebuild_build_extension: review the build_extension method that configures and runs cmake for a single gtn extension module
